response.original_title: 【Quick™Guest Assist】 → Can I Add an Extra Passenger After Booking a Seabourn Cruise?
response.overview: UK travelers can use 44-289-708-0062, while US guests can call 1-855-732-4023 to ask whether another passenger can be added to a Seabourn reservation. The request may depend on suite capacity, availability, fare conditions, and the status of the existing booking. Keep your reservation reference, sailing date, and existing passenger details ready when requesting the addition. Customer service can explain the available options, any additional fare, and requirements before the reservation is updated.
